name: SUNSURIA
recent: Sunsuria 正推进以约 RM316.84 million 向 Amazon Data Services Malaysia 出售 Dengkil 商业地皮，并将在 2026 年 12 月 21 日召开 EGM 寻求股东批准。同期，执行主席 Tan Sri Datuk Ter Leong Yap 及集团首席财务官 Yeap Yen Yen 在公开市场多次增持公司股份。
notable: Sunsuria City Sdn Bhd 与 Amazon Data Services Malaysia Sdn Bhd 签订有条件买卖协议，以约 RM316.84 million 出售 Dengkil 商业地皮。
公司将于 2026 年 12 月 21 日召开 EGM，寻求股东批准上述地皮出售事项。
执行主席 Tan Sri Datuk Ter Leong Yap 及集团首席财务官 Yeap Yen Yen 在公开市场增持公司股份。

news.title: Sunsuria to divest land for RM316.84mil
Amazon buys 2 million sq ft land in Selangor, Malaysia to build data center
Sunsuria proposes RM316.84m Sepang land sale to Amazon Data Services Malaysia
Sunsuria Unit To Sell Dengkil Land for RM316.84 Mln

recent_en: Sunsuria is proceeding with the proposed disposal of a commercial land parcel in Dengkil to Amazon Data Services Malaysia for approximately RM316.84 million, with an EGM scheduled on 21 December 2026 to seek shareholder approval. Meanwhile, Executive Chairman Tan Sri Datuk Ter Leong Yap and Group CFO Yeap Yen Yen have acquired shares in the open market on several occasions.
notable_en: Sunsuria City Sdn Bhd entered into a conditional sale and purchase agreement with Amazon Data Services Malaysia Sdn Bhd to dispose of a commercial land parcel in Dengkil for approximately RM316.84 million.
Executive Chairman Tan Sri Datuk Ter Leong Yap and Group CFO Yeap Yen Yen acquired shares in the open market.
